precisionAtK.definition: For each positive query: number of relevant expected source documents in deduplicated top min(3, returned document count) divided by that actual count. Empty result gives 0. Average over LQ1-LQ4. Do not divide by 3 when only one or two candidates exist.

recallAtK.definition: Expected document must be present in top-3 unique eligible document candidates for every LQ1-LQ4

acceptance.sourceSelection: LQ1/LQ2 select L1 only; LQ3/LQ4 select L2 only; LQ5/LQ6 select no source.
acceptance.grounding: Customer technical answer must consist only of approved selected literal excerpts; no invented ping/coverage/standards/discount/price claims; model message is not proof of grounding.
acceptance.authority: L1/L2 require actual trusted test publication approval/current hash/version/valid dates/admin_reviewed metadata; synthetic source must never be labeled official FPT. Revalidate immediately before rendering.
acceptance.authorityLiveScope: Two-document live smoke test cannot demonstrate all conflicts/supersession scenarios; retain 41/41 and 24/24 offline regressions, report live scope honestly.
acceptance.safety: No secrets/metadata/PII/unsolicited registration; no business fact override; no production connection; no unexpected request; customer JSON excludes full structured object.
acceptance.latencyTargetDefinition: Embedding <=5s and complete turn <=10s measured excluding deliberate quota-spacing sleeps; target failures reported separately from semantic failures.
acceptance.passingRule: All six content/source cases and safety gates must pass; report latency and retrieval metric failures explicitly. Partial run stopped on failure is NOT PASS.

quota.schedule: Serial; at least 65 seconds between sends to the same model, no concurrent requests or retry. Reserve project-level capacity; other consumers can exhaust it.

requestControl.transport: LiveSafety durable ledger + SinglePostWire one-shot TLS HTTP/1.1 POST; scoped CLI harness injects existing worker/retrieval/Engine. Runtime provider transports are never called.
requestControl.allowedMethodsAndEndpoints: POST only, exact fixed embedding endpoint and exact approved Gemini generateContent model endpoint; reject all other methods/hosts/operations
requestControl.attemptReservation: Consume unique operation ordinal and global request slot atomically BEFORE network send, including failed/time-out requests; reject a reused ordinal
requestControl.retries: Internal adapter retries or engine repair/fallback must be blocked at transport boundary, not counted as new approved operations
requestControl.metadata: No outbound GET: prevalidated metadata evidence may be injected locally; do not invoke default metadata HTTP transport
requestControl.abort: First HTTP/vector/database/schema/source/grounding/security failure stops entire plan; if fewer than 14 sent, do not use remaining budget
requestControl.evidenceFailure: Fail closed before sending if lock/counter/evidence storage cannot be secured

adapterAudit.embedding: GeminiEmbeddingService currently verifies metadata via GET on first call and may attempt up to 3 sends; its own HTTP transport disables redirects.
adapterAudit.chat: GeminiProvider disables its retries when responseSchema is set, but ConsultationEngine can repair/fallback. GeminiProvider.openConnection does not explicitly disable redirects.
adapterAudit.requirement: Every real outbound path needs the reviewed budget/operation guard plus redirects disabled. Current adapters are NOT sufficient to enforce the proposed plan.

executionEvidence.existingPhase23Files: Read-only; never reset/overwrite/copy over old locks or results
executionEvidence.lockBehavior: Atomic CreateNew after separate approval and all preflight gates; persist plan hash and approved budget (no key). Existing lock OR any orphan results forbid execution.
executionEvidence.operationLedger: Unique per-operation CREATE_NEW reservation/evidence; prevent double sends even after crash. No resume under this PlanId.
executionEvidence.sanitizedSummary: Unique CREATE_NEW result per operation plus final summary; reserve paths before send and finalize only files owned by this run. Evidence directory .build/phase24-live/<planId>.evidence; orchestration lock .build/phase24-orchestration/<planId>.lock. Frozen plan held read-only across preflight and execution.
